title: Twitter Feed — Hybrid Fanout (Advanced)
subtitle: Push for regular users, pull-on-read for celebrities

nodes.label:
Tweet Service
Store tweet
Check follower count

Fanout Worker
Fetch follower IDs
LPUSH to each timeline

Timeline Service (read)
1. LRANGE timeline:{user} 0 99
2. Fetch celebrity tweets
3. Merge + sort by timestamp

Celebrity Tweet Store
Store in celebrity cache only
(no fanout on write)

panels.title: Redis cache keys
panels.body:
# Regular user timeline (fanout on write)
timeline:user123  → [tweetId9, tweetId8, …, tweetId1]

# Celebrity cache (no fanout)
celeb:tweets:elonmusk  → sorted set (score = timestamp)

# Follower threshold check
GET follower_count:userId  → "18500"  (celebrity!)

panels.title: Tradeoffs
cons: Read path more complex (must merge two sources)
Slight latency increase for reads (celebrity fetch)
Threshold boundary (9.9K vs 10K followers) can be inconsistent
